contests.title: Gillett School District — Temporary school-revenue increase

provenance.quote: BE IT RESOLVED by the School Board of the Gillett School District, Oconto and Shawano Counties, Wisconsin, that the revenues included in the School District budget be authorized to exceed the revenue limit specified in Section 121.91, of the Wisconsin Statutes, by $1,900,000 in each year for the 2026-2027, the 2027-2028, and the 2028-2029 school years, for non-recurring purposes to sustain student educational programming, operations, and facilities maintenance.

measures.questionText: Shall the Gillett School District, Oconto and Shawano Counties, Wisconsin, be authorized to exceed the revenue limit specified in Section 121.91, of the Wisconsin Statutes, by $1,900,000 in each year for the 2026-2027, the 2027-2028, and the 2028-2029 school years, for non-recurring purposes, to sustain student educational programming, operations, and facilities maintenance?

measureRecords.whatItDoes: Allows the district to raise $1.9 million a year above Wisconsin’s school-revenue limit for three school years, from 2026–27 through 2028–29, to support student educational programs, operations, and facility maintenance. This temporary authorization ends after those years.
